title: Maplebrook Word Solitaire
subtitle: Sort words, ready the fairs
shortDescription: A cozy solitaire where you sort word cards into categories.
description:
Help the woodland villagers of Maplebrook get their seasonal fairs ready. Every level is a solitaire deal of word cards: find the category each word belongs to, clear the columns before your moves run out, and meet the villagers along the journey map.
